historical_record.description: A reinforced concrete and glass light-industrial building put up in 1926 to house the Traung Lithography and Label Company, designed by Maurice Couchot and Jesse Rosenwald, with Gothic Revival detail at the Battery Street entrances and industrial sash windows.
An abutting addition of the same height and style was completed in 1937 to Rosenwald's design.
In its natural state the ground lay under the shallow water of Yerba Buena Cove; by 1913 a single narrow rectangular building housing a paper manufacturer stood on the lot.

unknowns.downtown-1995-2011-0028: The 1998 environmental review for the 640 Battery Street office building expansion dates the first structure on the site to 1926 in one chapter and to 1927 in another, and in one place gives 600 Battery Street as the 1927 building and 640 Battery Street as the 1937 addition.
